observations: White wedge-shaped home game console with three visible layers, consistent with a PlayStation 4 Pro design.
Two red-and-white boxes labeled "Wireless Controller" with "FOR" visible; controller images shown through clear windows.
Black power cable and other black cables coiled on top of the console.
Console resting on stacked cardboard boxes.
Watermark text "POSTED ON JIJI" and "GAME ARENA OFFICIAL" overlaid on the image.
No readable model number, serial number, or "PlayStation" brand text visible on the console or boxes in this photo.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a console resembling a PS4 Pro but no readable brand or model label; seller's text is not proof.

claims.claim: It delivers smoother gameplay and faster performance.
claims.evidence: Performance cannot be assessed from photos; requires video of gameplay.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or has hardware faults.
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the home screen and running a game.

risks.risk: It is not a PS4 Pro (could be an original PS4 or Slim).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model label on the rear or bottom of the console.

risks.risk: Controllers are not genuine or do not sync.
risks.proof: Close-up of controller labels and video of controllers connecting to the console.

risks.risk: Power cable or HDMI cable is missing or incompatible with Nigerian voltage.
risks.proof: Photo of all included cables and the power input label showing voltage.
risks.if_unproven: as missing cables or requiring a voltage converter

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model and serial label on the back or bottom of the console.
Video of the console powering on, navigating the menu, and launching a game.
Close-up of the controller boxes and controllers showing any branding, plus video of them syncing.
Photo of all cables and the power supply label.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a home game console from photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case while listing the proof that would raise the value.
